title: ADHD in Relationships: How It Shapes Love, Conflict, and Connection
summary: Living with ADHD in relationships brings unique challenges. Learn how routines, communication, and self-accountability can help to show up as a stronger partner.
body_markdown:
## How to Manage ADHD in a Relationship


One of the biggest lessons I had to learn as someone living with both neurodivergence and mental illness is that, while both can make some aspects of life more difficult, it is ultimately my own responsibility to manage them at the end of the day. This is especially true when it comes to ADHD. It may cause struggles during work, school, or personal life, but it isn’t fair to expect a romantic partner to always pick up the slack in those areas.


Staying medicated consistently has been one of the best things I have ever done for my ADHD and mental health. Under the care of my medical providers, I’ve found that taking my medication as prescribed helps me manage my symptoms. In my dating life, this also helps minimize the effect my condition may have on potential partners. If the roles were reversed, I would want a partner to take full accountability and responsibility for their own diagnosis, so it’s only fair that I set myself up to do the same – both for my own well-being and that of a future life partner.
